evidence: on-redhat-firewalld-masked-chrony-and-the-yum-scripts: node_base.pp:140-147 is the RedHat branch's include ::chrony (custom_ntp false in the fixture), so chronyd active is what it declares; with lines 63-76 (firewalld stopped/disabled, exec systemctl mask) and 110-111 (filesystem_yum, whose baseline installs yum-update-surface.sh/yum-update-dist.sh in place of filesystem_apt) the expected masked/inactive/active/yum scripts present/0 apt-update scripts is what the code produces on rhel9

production-parameters-strict-keep-and-boot-run: node_base.pp:162-165 includes puppet_boot_run when run_puppet_on_boot is true (prod params set it); puppet_boot_run's baseline installs ${bindir}/puppet_boot_run.sh root:root 0750 and enables the puppet_boot_run service, matching enabled and root:root 750; the 0 '110 SSH' rules follows line 101 forwarding ssh_strict=true to firewall_secure, whose strict branch (lines 87-90) declares no 110 rule

the-base-components-are-all-applied: node_base.pp:55-57 declares sysmon_base, whose baseline installs ${localdir}/bin/nagios-puppet.sh (sysmon-scripts sentinel) and selects monitoring-plugins-standard on Ubuntu; packages_base's list holds aptitude, firewall_ipv6_drop, filesystem_lib64 and filesystem_apt give the other sentinels, so the expect follows from the composed components under the params fixture

purpose covered: The purpose (hardened SSH, default-drop firewall with the ACL and IPv6 drop, base packages without unattended upgrades, server-mode apt scripts, restricted tools, NTP, DNS left alone, no boot run) matches the header and baseline node_base.pp. The base run tests SSH behaviour over loopback (publickey only, kex/cipher refusal with a real cipher mismatch, root login no), the firewall policy/whitelist/limit chain, NTP actually synchronising, tool group/mode and component sentinels; the rhel variant tests the RedHat branch (firewalld masked, chrony, filesystem_yum) on rhel9; the prod variant tests strict SSH firewall, the boot-run unit, and that with firewall_strict_purge false and ignore pattern p8test-keep the next agent run keeps the matching planted rule and purges the other (both would be purged if node_base did not forward them, per firewall_secure.pp:37-51). The accepted-gap row lists exactly the 32 parameters other than the five production sets (fleet_variant_usage.md lines 102-106); each component's own set covers its behaviour. Nothing the lab can exercise is left out.
